reviewer: Claude, acting under the repository owner's instruction in chat; every transcribed row re-located in a fresh copy of its source by an automated text check in the browser
authorization: Claude, 2026-10-29: 'Shall I add lead-acid batteries (AGM, gel, flooded) so those filters have something in them?'
Owner: 'yes but they should not be allowerd to use for battery design which is related to lithiom ion and na ion, otherwise it is a mess. I will make part later for them'
scope: 97 lead-acid batteries from 21 first-party sources (Victron Energy, Trojan Battery, Exide, Yuasa, EnerSys ODYSSEY, Clarios VARTA): AGM, gel, flooded and EFB across deep-cycle/solar, standby/UPS and engine starting. 35 are 2 V cells, 62 are 6 V or 12 V monoblocs (modules). Adds schema/139 (minute unit; cranking_current, reserve_capacity, float_charge_voltage, cyclic_charge_voltage, equalize_charge_voltage, short_circuit_current), files the four lead-acid designations and the PbO2/Pb couple in web/data/technologies-and-chemistries.json, and adds the per-technology 'design' flag (true only for lithium-ion and sodium-ion). No existing accepted record is changed.

identity_policy.manufacturer: The company the source names as maker or issuer; brands stay in the model (Sonnenschein, ODYSSEY, VARTA).
identity_policy.duplicates: tools/check_duplicates.py: zero exact, zero probable; the three review collisions are pre-existing Renata coin cells
identity_policy.variants: ODYSSEY terminal variants (F, M, R, A ...) are separate part numbers and separate records; old part numbers are aliases.

design_exclusion: Lead-acid has design: false. The battery-data finder marks these rows 'Not for Lemonergy Design'; the hub shortlist, its 'Open in Design' hand-off and the discharge calculator refuse them.
